name: wmkf_apprequestperson-institution-at-award
_comment: Owner + Connor decision 2026-10-20: per-award institution snapshot on the PI/co-PI junction, as a lookup to account. The contact's own account link stays the person's CURRENT institution; this column keeps where they were when this request was made/awarded, so a later move changes only the contact. GoApply's submission flow (Connor) fills it for new co-PIs; the 2017-2023 Research co-PI recovery backfill fills existing rows. Nullable; additive only. Default cascade (Delete: Restrict) matches the wave4 wmkf_portalmembership account lookup and keeps award history from being silently unlinked by an account delete.

relationships.lookupDescription: The person's institution (account) for this request at the time of submission/award. Does not change if the person later moves; the contact's account holds their current institution.
